slug: 从车迟国开始布局西游
lines: 如意真仙带着扶苏和王翦离开过后，江辰也直接起身找上了红云。
大秦都已经来到车迟国了，红云立教的时间也到了，他倒是想看看红云立教接引是个什么反应。
江辰来到五庄观的时候红云正和镇元子两人正在论道，镇元子看见江辰来了直接开口道：“江辰道友，你今天怎么有时间来贫道这五庄观？”
江辰笑着开口道：“镇元子道友，贫道今日是为了红云道友来的。”
红云有些疑惑的开口：“江辰道友，你找贫道有何事？”
江辰来到石桌旁坐下，然后开口：“红云道友，你立教的时机已经到了，今日贫道来寻你就是为了这件事而来。”
镇元子眼睛亮了：“道友此言当真？”
江辰点了点头：“那是自然，我那徒儿的大军已经拿下了车迟国，红云道友可直接在车迟国立教。”
红云有些不好意思的开口道：“江辰道友，贫道对立教毫无头绪，这......”
江辰淡淡开口道：“无妨，咱们可以集思广益嘛。”
红云面露喜色：“还请道友指教？”
江辰淡淡开口道：“红云道友，一般来说立教最重要的无非只有两点。”
“第一是所立教派的受众，第二则是教义，只要这核心的两点搞清楚了便可立教，道友可以顺着这个思路往下想......”
江辰说了足足半个时辰，直接以截教为模板把立教的这两个核心掰开揉碎讲给了红云。
红云听了江辰的话低头沉思起来，自己所建立的教派受众是什么人?教义是什么？
想着想着红云竟陷入顿悟状态。
镇元子看见红云陷入顿悟状态乐呵呵的看向江辰:“贫道与他都是闲云野鹤之人，哪里知道立教需要什么东西啊？若没有江辰道友，红云不知道什么时候才会找到头绪呢。”
江辰淡淡一笑:“道友客气了，咱们可是盟友，能够帮助一二贫道自然不会藏着掖着。”
镇元子看向红云开口问道:“江辰道友，依你看红云道友这顿悟需要多长时间？”
江辰略微思索了一下，然后摇了摇头:“这个贫道也说不准，短则十天半月，长则三年五年。”
镇元子开口问道:“道友，这会不会影响到你的计划?”
江辰摇了摇头:“不会，佛门现在也已经在我截教的掌控下，红云道友立教早晚都不会影响到我的计划。”
镇元子听江辰这么说，直接惊呼出声:“什么？佛门已经被截教掌控?难道截教又诞生了一位混元大罗金仙境的强者?”
要知道佛门可是有两位圣人的，虽然准提被江辰给关押起来了，可接引可还是在须弥山的。
截教既然掌控了佛门，那说明肯定出动了一位修为与接引不相上下的人坐镇佛门，否则根本做不到。
截教他知道的修为能压接引一头的只有通天和江辰，江辰现在就在自己眼前，而通天则是截教教主。
如此看来必定是截教又有人突破到混元大罗金仙的境界了！

After True Immortal Ruyi left with Fusu and Wang Jian, Jiang Chen stood up and went to Hongyun.
Great Qin had already arrived in Chechi Kingdom, and it was time for Hongyun to establish a sect. He wanted to see Hongyun's reaction to the establishment of a sect.
When Jiang Chen came to Wuzhuang Temple, Hong Yunzheng and Zhen Yuanzi were discussing Taoism. Zhen Yuanzi saw Jiang Chen coming and said directly: "Fellow Taoist Jiang Chen, why do you have time to come to Pindao Wuzhuang Temple today?"
Jiang Chen smiled and said, "Fellow Taoist Zhen Yuanzi, Pindao is here today for Taoist friend Hongyun."
Hongyun said with some confusion: "Fellow Taoist Jiang Chen, what do you want from Pindao?"
Jiang Chen came to the stone table and sat down, and then said: "Fellow Taoist Hongyun, the time has come for you to establish a religion. This is why I came to find you today."
Zhen Yuanzi's eyes lit up: "Fellow Taoist, are you serious about what you said?"
Jiang Chen nodded: "That's natural. My disciple's army has already captured Chechi Country. Fellow Daoist Hongyun can directly establish a religion in Chechi Country."
Hongyun said with some embarrassment: "Fellow Taoist Jiang Chen, I have no clue about the opposite religion. This..."
Jiang Chen said calmly: "It doesn't matter, we can brainstorm ideas."
Hongyun's face was filled with joy: "Can you please give me some advice from fellow Taoist?"
Jiang Chen said calmly: "Fellow Taoist Hongyun, generally speaking, there are only two most important points in establishing a religion."
"The first is the audience of the established sect, and the second is the doctrine. As long as these two core points are clear, the sect can be established. Fellow Taoists can think along this line of thinking..."
Jiang Chen talked for a full half an hour, using Jiejiao as a template to break apart the two core points of Lijiao and tell them to Hongyun.
After listening to Jiang Chen's words, Hongyun lowered his head and thought deeply. Who is the audience of the sect he founded? What are its doctrines?
Thinking about it, Hongyun actually fell into a state of enlightenment.
When Zhen Yuanzi saw Hong Yun falling into a state of enlightenment, he looked at Jiang Chen happily: "Ping Dao and he are both from Xian Yun Ye He, how do we know what is needed to establish a religion? Without fellow Taoist Jiang Chen, Hong Yun doesn't know when he will find the clue."
Jiang Chen smiled faintly: "You're welcome, fellow Taoist. We are allies. If we can help a poor Taoist, we won't hide it."
Zhen Yuanzi looked at Hongyun and asked, "Fellow Taoist Jiang Chen, how long do you think it will take for Taoist Hongyun to have this epiphany?"
Jiang Chen thought for a moment, then shook his head: "I can't say for sure. It could be as short as ten days and a half month, or as long as three to five years."
Zhen Yuanzi asked: "Fellow Taoist, will this affect your plan?"
Jiang Chen shook his head: "No, Buddhism is now under the control of my Jiejiao. Sooner or later, Hongyun Daoist friend's establishment of the sect will not affect my plan."
When Zhen Yuanzi heard what Jiang Chen said, he exclaimed: "What? Buddhism has been controlled by Jie Jiao? Could it be that Jie Jiao gave birth to another strong man in the Hunyuan Da Luo Jin Fairyland?"
You must know that there are two saints in Buddhism. Although Zhunti was imprisoned by Jiang Chen, he was still detained in Mount Sumeru.
Since Jie Jiao controls Buddhism, it means that he must have dispatched a person whose cultivation level is comparable to that of Jie Yin to sit in Buddhism, otherwise it would be impossible.
The only people he knew in Jie Jiao whose cultivation level could surpass him were Tong Tian and Jiang Chen. Jiang Chen was right in front of him now, and Tong Tian was the leader of Jie Jiao.
From this it seems that someone in Jiejiao must have broken through to the realm of Hunyuan Daluo Jinxian!
